author: agent
sentences: After a long time freelancing, I finally raised my rates.
I charged $60 an hour, then I raised it to $95.
I lost a client, and the rest stayed.
This year I will earn about $110,000, working fewer hours than before.
Your rate tells clients how seriously to take you.

expected.say: $60 an hour, then I raised it to $95

notes: FromTo with a change verb (raised it to) between two hourly rates; a yearly dollar amount
